name: Inferno Viper
description: Born in the depths of hellfire, Inferno Viper is armored in volcanic scales that absorb punishment and redirect it as pure destructive force. A crimson predator that grows more dangerous the longer it endures.

special_move.name: Hellfire Dragon Breaker
special_move.description: Inferno Viper erupts in a column of hellfire, launching a devastating three-phase inferno burst that melts through armor and scorches the stadium!
flavour_texts: 🐉 **Hellfire 2** — Crimson scales absorb the explosion and REDIRECT it!

abilities.name: Inferno Viper
abilities.description: When Inferno Viper wins an Attack phase, its crimson fangs sink deeper — dealing 20 bonus damage and applying a Burn status on the enemy for 2 turns (10 damage per turn). Burn stacks up to 2 times.

abilities.name: Infernal Armor
abilities.description: Inferno Viper's volcanic armor absorbs incoming blows. Reduces all damage taken by 20. When HP drops below 50%, the armor superheats — reflecting 25 damage back to the attacker each time it takes a hit, for the rest of the battle.
